bio.text: Vanessa Oliver represents District 76 in the Florida House of Representatives, first elected in 2024, according to the House's official biography.
The profile lists Oliver as a CEO from Punta Gorda who was born in Boston and moved to Florida in 1988, and as vice chair of the Charlotte County Airport Authority.
Oliver holds a B.A. in economics from the College of William & Mary (2002) and a J.D. from the University of Florida Levin College of Law (2006).
